name: Code Candy Hover Expanding Login
useWhen: A project needs a dark login/signup card with a rotating cyan/magenta neon border that expands on hover/focus and switches auth modes only after explicit user clicks.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of a public Code Candy hover expanding login clip with partial visible CSS.
implementationNotes: Expansion must be hover/focus triggered, not autoplayed.
Sign up and sign in are implemented as explicit mode switches; do not leave either as dead links.
After a mode switch, click-away, focus-away, and Escape must collapse the sticky expanded state.
Use the visible 4-segment conic-gradient border values from the screenshot as the core motif.
Use real labeled inputs, validation, rate limiting, and secure backend auth in production.
Keep source-video headlines and code frames out of production previews.
reducedMotion: Stop the rotating conic gradient, keep the neon border visible as a static frame, and preserve hover/focus states.
avoid: using it for plain enterprise auth
